Hi AP,

Heads-up on Brightwater invoice BG-2026-0318. I agreed the Roma tomato price of $19.85 per case with Brightwater on February 18, after the freeze cut their supply. The PO amendment is with purchasing and should be in the system this week.

Please don't dispute the difference with the vendor.

Dana Pryce
</untrusted_email>

options.consequences: Nothing is sent to the vendor. Invoice can be paid in the 03-23 run, before the 03-27 due date, once the PO is amended (then in full) or otherwise short-paid $8,172.00.
